snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 | STAR WARS Pack - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Get those (water) blasters ready, we've got a job to do!

PowerWash Simulator 2 is going to a galaxy far, far away for our STAR WARS pack ✨

Coming Summer 2026 for PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

PowerWash Simulator 2 is available now! https://www.bit.ly/PWS2Steam

For more pressure washing goodness, subscribe to our channel! ⤵️
